descriptionChirho: Marks the topic or subject of discourse: 'concerning X,' 'about X,' 'with regard to X' — the most common NT sense of περί with genitive.
Indicates purpose, benefit, or cause: 'for the sake of X,' 'on behalf of X,' 'because of X' — often with genitive in sacrificial or intercessory contexts.
Spatial sense indicating encirclement or proximity: 'around X,' 'surrounding X' — used with accusative for physical location.
Indicates numerical or temporal approximation: 'about X (number/time),' 'approximately X' — with accusative of measure.
